emails.subject: Hotel is closed?? — please cancel booking #WN-2026-04829
emails.body:
Hi,

I have been standing outside my hotel for OVER AN HOUR and nobody is here. I just want to cancel this booking and find somewhere else to sleep tonight, please.

What happened: I booked at 2:08pm today for one night at Harborview Inn, a Queen Room, $186.40 total. The app showed:
  - 2:09pm  "Confirmed by property"
  - 3:21pm  "Check-in instructions sent"
  - 6:34pm  I arrived and tapped check-in in the app
  - (nothing has changed since then. it is now 7:42pm.)

The lobby is completely dark and the front door is locked. There's no sign on the door. I've called the inn's number over and over — it just rings out, nobody picks up. My airport shuttle driver, Luis, waited with me for a while and said it looked like the place was shut for the night, then he had to go on to his next pickup. So as far as I can tell the inn is just CLOSED, even though the app told me they confirmed my booking this afternoon.

I JUST WANT TO CANCEL THIS BOOKING. Please cancel it and refund my card. It's getting dark and I need to book another hotel before everything nearby fills up.

Booking details for your reference:
  Booking ID: WN-2026-04829
  Property: Harborview Inn
  Room: 1x Queen Room, 1 night, check-in 2026-04-28
  Room rate: $158.00
  Taxes/fees: $28.40
  Total: $186.40
  Traveler email on file: hana.kobayashi@gmail.com
  Status timeline (from the app):
    [14:09] Confirmed by property
    [15:21] Check-in instructions sent
    [18:34] Guest arrived at property (app geo check-in attempt)
    [—— no further events ——]
    [Current status: "Awaiting guest check-in — 1h 8min"]
  (No "Front desk checked guest in" event.)
  (No "Room assigned" event.)

Thanks. Please just cancel.

— Hana
